message.text: Ready to dispatch. spawn_agent: role `task-mastermind`, name `waiting-on-you`, model `claude-opus-5-5`, effort `medium`, `bypassPermissions`. Prompt: "You own one task. Your brief is ai/2026-09-28/waiting-on-you/requirements.md, and your task log is task.jsonl beside it. Work in one worktree of your own. Prove every Servex change on a private Servex first, and restart the live one once at the end. Land with a checklist of the owner's asks, each with its proof. Post progress on card 2026/09/28/waiting-on-you-never-buried, two sentences at a time." What it builds: a "Waiting on you" strip at the top of AI 2. Every question an agent asks you stays there until you answer it, and each answer wakes the agent that asked.

Taken. Three Sonnet minions share one worktree: one builds card_ask, answering and list_waiting in Servex, one builds the strip at /framework/ai2/waiting/, and one moves every question already waiting on you onto a card.
